d:
Lallantop Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar reached a beautiful village of Jharkhand. It is near Jamshedpur and most of the people here belong to Santhal tribe. People in this village have made collective efforts to make their village beautiful.
Is vidiyo ka kopirait svamitv indiya tude grup ke pas hai. indiya tude grup ki anumti ke bina, kisi tisre paksh ko vidiyo ka upyog karne ki aagya nahin hai. upyog ki anumti is eemel aaeedi ke madhyam se prapt ki ja sakti hai.
Produced By: The Lallantop
Edited By: Vijay
